How it works

A transparent process for submitting, verifying and tracking your deposit or withdrawal.

01

Choose a company and service

Select one of the available platforms, then choose deposit or withdrawal. Check that the requested service is enabled before continuing.

02

Enter your transaction details

Provide the amount, platform account ID and destination details needed to route your request correctly. Never enter passwords, OTPs, seed phrases or private keys.

03

Select the displayed payment method

Choose an active mobile-money number, bank account or wallet listed by the administrator. Match the beneficiary and, for crypto, the exact network before sending funds.

04

Submit your payment reference

After making a payment, submit its reference or transaction hash in your transaction history. A reference helps with review but does not alone prove that funds arrived.

05

Follow status updates

Check My Transactions for the latest status and any support note. The team verifies receipt and performs the requested service before marking it complete.

06

Know what each status means

Awaiting payment means payment is not yet confirmed; Processing means work is underway; Completed should appear only after the required checks and fulfilment are done.

Before you send money

Check the beneficiary, account number, fees and exact network. If payment details are missing or do not match, stop and contact support. Ipay records and tracks requests; it does not automatically transfer funds.

Terms of service

Service scope, responsibilities and acceptable use.

Service requests

Ipay records customer instructions and tracks service progress. Submitting a request does not itself transfer funds or guarantee that a payment has been received.

Customer responsibilities

Check recipient details, supported networks, account identifiers, fees and provider rules before sending funds. Never share passwords, OTPs, seed phrases or private keys.

Processing

A request may require manual review. Completion should be recorded only after the relevant payment and service steps have been verified.

Privacy policy

How transaction information is handled.

Information used

The platform may store account details, contact information, transaction instructions, payment references, status history and audit records needed to provide and secure the service.

Access and protection

Account access is protected by sign-in and appropriate access controls. Never submit passwords, one-time codes, seed phrases or private keys in transaction forms.

Retention

Transaction records may be retained for support, fraud prevention, accounting and applicable legal obligations.

Refund & dispute policy

How transaction concerns are reviewed.

Report a problem

Provide the transaction reference and accurate supporting details. The team reviews the payment record and provider evidence before making a decision.

Incorrect details or network

Transfers sent to an incorrect account or blockchain network may be irreversible. Recovery is not guaranteed and may depend on the receiving provider.

Resolution

Requests remain under review until relevant evidence has been checked. A status update is not a substitute for proof of payment.

Payment information

Review payment instructions before sending.

Use the details shown for your request

Payment accounts may vary by provider, network and availability. Confirm the exact beneficiary and account number before transferring.

Crypto transfers

USDT networks are not interchangeable. Send only on the exact network displayed for the receiving wallet. Blockchain transfers are generally irreversible.

Verification

A transaction reference or screenshot helps the team review a payment but does not by itself prove funds were received.
